draft.text:
Hello,

Your doctor has made changes to your medicines. Please follow the list below exactly. Do not change any dose without speaking to your doctor.

Medicines to take:
- Coudin: 4 mg a day
- Vicodin: 5/500 mg q.4-6h
- Continue your home medications.

You have a follow-up appointment. Please arrive 15 minutes early and bring your discharge papers.
- Follow up with Dr. ABC in two - weeks.

You need a blood test. Please go to the hospital laboratory on the date shown. Bring this message with you.
- twice weekly lab checks

Get medical help immediately if you notice any of the warning signs below.
- Call the office or return to the emergency room for any concerns including increased redness, swelling, drainage, fever, or any concerns regarding operation or site of incision.
